description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case for the ReviewerRating entity in the OrangeHRM performance module. It sets up test data, persists entities, and verifies the correct behavior of the ReviewerRating entity, including its relationships to other entities like PerformanceReview, Reviewer, and Kpi.

classes.name: ReviewerRatingTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ReviewerRating entity, including setup and entity relationship validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific tables related to PerformanceReview, Reviewer, Kpi, JobTitle, and ReviewerRating entities to ensure a clean state before each test.

methods.name: testReviewerRatingEntity
methods.description: Creates instances of related entities, sets their properties, persists them, and verifies the correctness of the ReviewerRating entity and its relationships.
